propositions: Auto-deploy restarts review-bot container during in-flight code reviews, causing timeout of the 45-second drain window before the 1200-second review completes, which results in teardown-corrupted review casting a fail-closed -1 vote that blocks automatic backfill reconciliation

Fail-closed votes from retryable coverage-gap conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should be replaced with vote-less deferral to leave changes eligible for the existing backfill reconciler re-drive mechanism

Drain shutdown timeout must be extended from 45 seconds to 1200 seconds to match the per-review timeout, and stop_grace_period must be resized to 1320 seconds to allow in-flight reviews to complete before container termination

A bounded escalation mechanism must track review retry attempts per (change_id, revision) and only cast the fail-closed -1 vote after exceeding a configurable retry limit (default 3), emitting VOTER_ERROR to surface the condition

Retryable coverage-gap deferral must post no vote and no provisional comment to the change, leaving it invisible to the voted ledger so the backfill reconciler will re-drive it within RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS

Terminal outcomes (finding, indeterminate, gate-disabled) must continue casting fail-closed -1 votes, and PASS outcomes must continue casting +1 votes, with no behavior change for non-retryable conditions
